Container.Name: BlackMesa-Coop
Container.Overview: Black Mesa Dedicated Server running the SourceCoop cooperative mod (Metamod:Source + SourceMod). The game server (~30 GB) is downloaded into the appdata folder on first start and updated on every restart. Use the container console (or docker attach) for the server console.
Container.Requires: Forward 27015 TCP and UDP on your router so friends can join over the internet.

Config.Name: Server data
Config.Description: Game server, addons and configs (~30 GB). Configs live in server/bms/cfg.

Config.Name: Server name
Config.Description: Name shown in the server browser.

Config.Name: Server password
Config.Description: Password players need to join. Leave empty for an open server.

Config.Name: RCON password
Config.Description: Remote console password. Leave empty to disable RCON (recommended; use SourceMod admins instead).

Config.Name: Start map
Config.Description: Map loaded on startup (bm_c0a0a = start of the campaign).

Config.Name: Update on start
Config.Description: Run SteamCMD update on every container start.

Config.Name: Validate files
Config.Description: Verify all game files with SteamCMD on start (slow). Use if the server is broken.

Config.Name: SourceCoop version
Config.Description: 'latest' or a release tag such as v1.6.

Config.Name: SourceMod URL
Config.Description: Empty = SourceMod 1.12 build 7163 (the version SourceCoop requires). 'latest' = newest 1.12 build, or a full .tar.gz URL.

Config.Name: Delete texture VPKs
Config.Description: Delete texture packs the server does not need (saves ~9 GB).

Config.Name: Extra launch args
Config.Description: Extra srcds arguments, e.g. +sv_setsteamaccount TOKEN or -tickrate 66.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID files are owned by.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID files are owned by.
